verdict.rationale: Lighthouse is an immigration petition service with case software, so an AI-use disclosure is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the pack describes any use of AI in drafting or review, or separates automated steps from attorney-checked ones. The pricing page lists 'Attorney Review — Included' and the homepage describes document upload and tracking, but neither says what is automated, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider states how it uses AI in petition drafting and review — what is automated, what a human attorney checks — on its own pages
